title: Elon Musk’s Exes Are the Most Damning Part of a Massive New Documentary
gist: Alex Gibney's nearly four-hour documentary 'Musk' (in theaters October 16) draws its most damning material from ex-partners Justine Wilson and Ashley St. Clair, who allege cruelty, narcissism and retaliation; St. Clair says she rejected a $40 million NDA. The review argues the film's broader account of Musk's empire, DOGE and Trump alliance is convincing but familiar, and that Musk cannot buy everyone's silence.

insights.so_what: The size of the alleged NDA offer shows how much Musk reportedly values narrative control — and the cost when it fails.
